top_story_headline: NUVA adopts Chainlink as exclusive data infrastructure for institutional RWA tokenization, starting with nvPRIME backed by U.S. HELOC-linked loans.
top_story_comment: Chainlink can push NAV and reserve status onto Ethereum, but it cannot oracle away HELOC defaults or redemption liquidity. DeFi distribution is still tiny: nvPRIME shows $5.49M across 93 holders at a 5.15% net APY, versus roughly $13B of Figure RWA TVL in its September 2025 SEC filing.
